description: This Dart source file defines the WsClient class, which manages a WebSocket connection for real-time communication. It includes methods to connect, send messages, disconnect, and handle incoming data stream.

classes.name: WsClient
classes.description: A class providing WebSocket client functionality including connect, send, disconnect, and stream management.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection using a token retrieved from tokenProvider.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message with specified type and payload over the WebSocket.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Closes stream controller and socket, cleaning up resources.
